name: inmation-crash-dump-analyzer
description: Crash dump analysis for the inmation / OT Data Fabric server: the crash-dump-analyzer agent and the crash-dump-analysis skill with scripts that summarize Windows crash dumps (cdb, verified symbols, Lua / Web API context, C++ exception decoding), search TFS for existing bugs, and collect code evidence for the root cause. Works from any workspace; uses the inmation server repository when it is the workspace.
